007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ProfileAttributes;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ProfileStatus;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for creating a Select AI profile.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
022 * {@link ProfileAttributes} payload, call
023 * {@link SelectAI#profile(String, ProfileAttributes, String, ProfileStatus)},
024 * invoke {@link Profile#create()}, and print metadata for the created
025 * profile.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating the profile identified by
028 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}. Verify the profile name before running it.
029 * Use uppercase profile names, such as
030 * {@code SELECTAIJAVAPROFILENAME}, because Oracle stores normal unquoted
031 * identifiers in uppercase.</p>
032 *
033 * <p>To run this sample with an object list that references the Oracle
034 * sample schema objects {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES}, ensure
035 * the {@code SH} schema is installed and visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}.
036 * The {@code SH} schema is not guaranteed to exist in every Oracle Autonomous
037 * AI Database or Oracle Database instance. If those objects are not available,
038 * set {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST} to objects visible to
039 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, or omit the object list and rely on the configured
040 * object-list mode.</p>
041 *
042 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
043 * <ul>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER</li>
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
053 * <ul>
054 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION - profile description. Defaults to a
055 *       sample description.</li>
056 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_STATUS - initial profile status, such as
057 *       {@code enabled} or {@code disabled}. Defaults to the database default.</li>
058 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT - provider endpoint host/path.
059 *       The SDK does not derive provider endpoints from provider name, region,
060 *       or Azure resource name; set this variable when the profile requires
061 *       {@code provider_endpoint}.</li>
062 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_REGION - provider region.</li>
063 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE - object selection mode, such as
064 *       {@code automated} or {@code all}. Defaults to {@code automated}.</li>
065 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST - optional object-list JSON used when
066 *       constraining profile metadata. This value is not required when
067 *       {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE} is set; when omitted, object
068 *       selection follows database behavior for the supplied mode.</li>
069 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_MODEL - provider model identifier.</li>
070 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_API_FORMAT - OCI API format, such as {@code GENERIC}
071 *       or {@code COHERE}.</li>
072 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID - OCI compartment OCID.</li>
073 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_ENDPOINT_ID - OCI dedicated endpoint OCID.</li>
074 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE - OCI runtime type.</li>
075 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
076 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
077 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS - defaults to {@code 1024}.</li>
078 * </ul>
079 *
080 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
081 * <pre>{@code
082 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
083 * }</pre>
084 *
085 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
086 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
087 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
088 * <pre>{@code
089 * mvn clean install
090 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
091 * }</pre>
092 *
093 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
094 * <pre>{@code
095 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
096 *   -d samples/out \
097 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/CreateProfileSample.java
098 * }</pre>
099 *
100 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
101 * <pre>{@code
102 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
103 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.CreateProfileSample
104 * }</pre>
105 *
106 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
107 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
108 * and diagnostics.</p>
109 */
110public final class CreateProfileSample {
111    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateProfileSample.class);
112
113    private CreateProfileSample() {
114    }
115
116    public static void main(String[] args) {
117        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
118        String description = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION",
119                "Profile created by the Java Select AI SDK sample.");
120
121        try {
122            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
123            ProfileAttributes profileAttributes = buildProfileAttributes();
124            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName, profileAttributes, description, profileStatus());
125            boolean created = profile.create();
126
127            System.out.printf("Create profile '%s' completed: %s%n",
128                    valueOrEmpty(profile.getProfileName()), created);
129            System.out.printf("Status      : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getStatus()));
130            System.out.printf("Description : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getDescription()));
131        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
132            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
133        }
134    }
135
136    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
137        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
138                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
139                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
140                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
141                .build();
142
143        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
144    }
145
146    private static ProfileAttributes buildProfileAttributes() {
147        ProfileAttributes.Builder builder = ProfileAttributes.builder()
148                .credentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
149                .provider(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER"))
150                .objectListMode(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE", "automated"))
151                .comments(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS", "true")))
152                .constraints(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS", "true")))
153                .maxTokens(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS", "1024")));
154
155        applyOptionalString(builder::model, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_MODEL");
156        applyOptionalString(builder::additionalInstructions, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS");
157        applyOptionalString(builder::role, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ROLE");
158        applyOptionalString(builder::providerEndpoint, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT");
159        applyOptionalString(builder::region, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_REGION");
160        applyOptionalString(builder::objectList, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST");
161        applyOptionalString(builder::ociApiformat, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_API_FORMAT");
162        applyOptionalString(builder::ociCompartmentId, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID");
163        applyOptionalString(builder::ociEndpointId, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_ENDPOINT_ID");
164        applyOptionalString(builder::ociRuntimetype, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE");
165
166        return builder.build();
167    }
168
169    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
170        String value = System.getenv(envName);
171        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
172            setter.set(value);
173        }
174    }
175
176    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
177        String value = System.getenv(name);
178        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
179            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
180        }
181        return value;
182    }
183
184    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
185        String value = System.getenv(name);
186        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
187    }
188
189    private static ProfileStatus profileStatus() {
190        String value = System.getenv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_STATUS");
191        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : ProfileStatus.fromValue(value);
192    }
193
194    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
195        return value == null ? "" : value;
196    }
197
198    @FunctionalInterface
199    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
200        void set(String value);
201    }
202}
